shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#6 again at its new head (`09c968c`). The only change to figures and tables since my last review is my own Table 1 header fix, and the new Table 1 caption defines the synthetic worlds.

The rewritten Fig 3 caption now calls the real-pool rates joint rates over all draws. Panel (b)'s label in this head still read "real pool". I changed it to "real, all draws" and pushed that to my `main` and to `paper-repo` `dev` (`afee43b`). The figure is still 2.3 in high with a 7.0 pt minimum. It is not in this PR, so I asked `paper-repo` to take it into the next candidate.

Tab 3 still waits on `real_tool` from `experiment-repo`. The compute row of the measured-pool table still waits on a compute column in `matrix_facts`.
